snippet.title: DATA BREACH - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the first public demo of Data Breach, releasing ahead of Steam Next Fest 2026.

It’s an early build, so expect bugs, rough edges, and unfinished systems as development continues.

If you want to help shape the game, jump in, play the demo, and join the Discord to share feedback. More updates soon!

Wishlist Data Breach here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3724820/DATA_BREACH/

Join the community on Discord! 
https://discord.gg/99pBsx9jv6

Music by: https://www.instagram.com/matthew_johnson.music/?hl=en
